criteria.text: `python3 tracker-sidecar/tracker_sidecar.py --source mock --port 7900` starts, binds **127.0.0.1** by default, and completes the `hello` handshake with `capabilities:["person"]`, `detector:"mock"`.
`select` starts a scripted trajectory (configurable: stationary, sine sweep, exit-frame); `cancel` ends it; `lost` and `idle` are emitted per script.
Invalid/oversized/unknown messages produce an `error` frame, not a crash; the server survives client disconnects.
Emits `frameTs`/`processedAt` from a clock it controls so the app can test latency logic.
The real TypeScript `TrackingClient` (#27) connects to it and the manager (#26) drives `virtualDjiBridge` from its scripted output in one smoke scenario or a documented manual script.
